5744-6927-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5744-6927-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

339-574-677-7297.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
339-574-677-7297.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4289-4314--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4289-4314--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Pawn of Ulamog triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

997-1981-2415-3025.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

757-4221-5087-5663.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-4221-5087-5663.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Cayth to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Living Plane, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

3197-5870-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-5870-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3000-3899-4552-7280.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Donatello.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

2334-6995-7009.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
2334-6995-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Lulu by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

224-907-1772-3470.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Lotus Cobra trigger
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

1174-1479-1659.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}, one of which must enter the battlefield untapped.
1174-1479-1659.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Play the land returned to your hand in step 2.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and Seed the Land trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers, creating a token.
Repeat from step 7.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1844-5147-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Fateful Handoff.
1844-5147-5434-5555.description:
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1129-3812-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Allies.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1129-3812-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Harabaz Druid's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1754-2034-4766-5683.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents on the battlefield.
Deathrender attached to Guan Yu.
1754-2034-4766-5683.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Guan Yu, adding {C}{C}.
When Guan Yu dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Guan Yu trigger, causing you to shuffle it into your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Guan Yu and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Guan Yu from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.

1722-2034-3583-4716.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-4716.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1445-4033-4050-5037.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Basking Rootwalla into exile, targeting Blazing Rootwalla.
Basking Rootwalla's madness ability triggers, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Blazing Rootwalla from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Basking Rootwalla, adding {B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Blazing Rootwalla into exile, targeting Basking Rootwalla.
Blazing Rootwalla's madness ability triggers, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Basking Rootwalla from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Blazing Rootwalla, adding {B}.
Repeat.

483-643-1033-2869-4302.description:
Cast Captain's Call.
Two of the tokens die to the legend rule.
Cruel Celebrant and Bishop of Wings both trigger twice.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant triggers causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
Resolve the Bishop of Wings triggers creating two 1/1 white Spirit creature tokens with flying.
One Spirit token dies to the legend rule.
Cruel Celebrant and Bishop of Wings both trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bishop of Wings trigger creating a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.
Repeat from step 6.

1295-1368-2172-3581.notablePrerequisites: At least one additional card in your graveyard.
1295-1368-2172-3581.description:
Cast Underworld Breach by paying {1}{R}.
Kykar, Wind's Fury triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token with flying.
Underworld Breach resolves.
Activate Kykar by sacrifice a Spirit token, adding {R}.
Cast Burning Inquiry by paying {R}.
Kykar, Wind's Fury triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token with flying.
Resolve Bruning Inquiry, causing each player to draw three cards, then discard three cards at random.
Activate Kykar by sacrifice a Spirit token, adding {R}.
Cast Burning Inquiry from the graveyard for its escape cost by paying {R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Repeat until you have two or fewer cards in your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield and triggers, causing you to win the game.
